relationships.name: The Linux Foundation
relationships.label: Neutral host
relationships.title: TRACE Specification is an LF Project
relationships.description: TRACE, the receipt format, is hosted at the Linux Foundation as its own project (a Series of LF Projects). The specification, its intellectual property, its trademark and its conformance mark belong to that project under the Community Specification License and LF Projects policies, so no single company decides what passing the tests means. It has also been proposed to the Agentic AI Foundation as an early-stage Sandbox project.

relationships.name: OPAQUE Systems
relationships.label: Sponsor
relationships.description: OPAQUE funds the engineering, infrastructure and confidential-computing work behind AgenTrust, and contributes to the projects.

relationships.name: Microsoft
relationships.label: Open-source project home
relationships.description: Microsoft hosts the Agent Governance Toolkit, open-source software that checks what AI agents do against rules while they run. AgenTrust builds on it.

relationships.name: Technology Innovation Institute
relationships.label: Confirmed founding partner
relationships.description: TII is the confirmed AgenTrust founding partner. It keeps the work grounded in what a country needs when it runs AI on infrastructure it controls.

relationships.name: AMD
relationships.label: Founding member and hardware partner
relationships.description: AMD is a founding partner of AgenTrust. AMD and OPAQUE published a joint implementation blueprint for hardware-backed Confidential AI, and the AgenTrust code checks signed reports from AMD SEV-SNP processors back to AMD's root certificate.

relationships.name: Intel
relationships.label: Founding member and hardware partner
relationships.description: Intel is a founding partner of AgenTrust. The AgenTrust code checks signed reports from Intel TDX processors (DCAP v4 quotes) back to Intel's root certificate, tested on real Google Cloud C3 machines.

relationships.name: ServiceNow
relationships.label: OPAQUE customer implementation
relationships.description: OPAQUE publicly documents how ServiceNow used its Confidential AI Platform to reduce commission-inquiry workflows from days to seconds.

relationships.name: CSA Agentic Trust Framework
relationships.label: Public framework collaboration
relationships.description: The author of the CSA Agentic Trust Framework (ATF) publicly supports the Agent Governance Toolkit (AGT) as a reference implementation, a working example of the framework, and invited implementers to help shape its conformance specification.

relationships.name: PRONATIVE AI
relationships.label: Ecosystem Training & Adoption Partner
relationships.description: PRONATIVE AI works with AgenTrust to teach enterprise engineering teams how to run AI agents whose actions can be checked. The partnership includes joint training sessions and the planned addition of cMCP, cA2A and TRACE to PRONATIVE AI's AI-Native Engineering Foundry curriculum. PRONATIVE AI is also adopting the Microsoft Agent Governance Toolkit in its own delivery work and will publish implementation guidance once that work is public.

relationships.name: XRSI: Human Intelligence In The Loop
relationships.label: Ecosystem partner
relationships.title: Governance and Ecosystem Sustainability Partner
relationships.description: XRSI brings experience in governance, community building and keeping open projects going over the long term to the AgenTrust adoption programme.

relationships.name: Action State Group
relationships.label: Technical collaborator
relationships.title: Trust Registry and Verifiable Record Collaboration
relationships.description: Action State Group is working with AgenTrust on an open way to contribute to the TRACE Trust Registry, connecting TRACE receipts to neutral record-keeping and witness services that anyone can check independently.

relationships.name: Odystra AI
relationships.label: Startup supporter
relationships.title: Odystra AI
relationships.description: Odystra builds an agentic governance, risk, and compliance platform for regulated enterprises.

relationships.name: o1Labs
relationships.label: Startup supporter
relationships.title: o1Labs
relationships.description: o1Labs develops applications and infrastructure built on zero-knowledge cryptography, which proves a statement is true without revealing the data behind it.
